meaning.source_text: SOP-AST-29658 v2.0 (April 2026; supersedes v1.0) — define Astellas CCI for disclosure of Astellas information in the public domain, and outline tracking.
Define Astellas CCI for disclosure of Astellas information in the public domain, and outline tracking.
This SOP applies to disclosure of Astellas information in the public domain.
Organizations in scope of this SOP.
Document-specific terms used in this SOP: CCI, Public Disclosure, Public Domain.
CCI: non-public technical/scientific/business know-how, trade secrets, proprietary; also info useful to competitors or harmful if disclosed.
Public Disclosure: disclosure of Astellas information in the public domain.

Public Domain: ClinicaTrials.gov, CTIS, EU CTR/EudraCT, jRCT, national registries, company website, TrialSummaries.com, journals, events, HMA-EMA RWD catalogue, HA clinical-data sites, HTA sites, EMA Policy 0043.
Packages can contain company secrets AND/OR participant/personnel PI/PPD. GUIDE for classification; FORM is the asset-specific library.
Asset Lead completes FORM with GUIDE + AMT/SMEs; revises on phase/CCI change; consults PD Lead.
Disclosure Document Coordinator prepares docs, uses FORM, escalates if not followed.
PD Lead maintains GUIDE, facilitates FORM, collects/reports, escalation.
D. Follow FORM or escalate before ship.
Asset Lead classify with GUIDE (may-be consult SME/Dept Head/Legal).
Check public domain — already public is not confidential.
If deviation, contact Asset Lead and PD Lead via publicdisclosure-sm@astellas.com before ship.
Verify in Public Disclosure Tracking Tool.
GUIDE-AST-6011 v2.0 (April 2026; supersedes v1.0) — CCI / may-be-CCI / not-CCI including phase.
Standards apply all phases, decreasing later/after MA.
Phase-decay: preclinical through Ph4, decreases later/after MA.

MAY-BE: DS names/structure early; quantitative composition; metabolite formulae/pathways that reveal manufacture; polymorphism/sequence; impurities; DS/DP manufacturing methods, sites, CMOs, specs, batch size, unpublished in-house cells; DP packaging technical specs; AAV fact of synthesis/formulation change.
Not-CCI: published/commercial cell-line names; general characterization; excipient names; standard storage; batch numbers; common techniques; fact of process change except AAV.

MAY-BE: unpublished novel MoA/concepts; metabolites until NDA/BLA; special substrate; exclusive assays; early results; CRO/site names; future plans; study dates; detailed HA advice; contractual strategy.
Not-CCI: ELISA/Biacore/common assays; published techniques; country names.
MAY-BE: unpublished patentable unit/daily/max dose (typ. Ph1); novel unqualified biomarkers; exclusive assays; non-label endpoints; third-party questionnaires when contract forbids disclosure.
Not-CCI: route/frequency/setting; design; results; CRO names; fact of HA consult.
MAY-BE: exposure calc, exposure/sales by country, projected exposure, product cost, net pricing.
